card.name: Numbers and units inside data tables
card.fires_on: The last digit or unit word (such as g or Days) of a number in a table of doses or measurements, where the next entry is another number or value. Also a repeated element symbol in a bond-strength table.

modes.label: Digit inside a decimal
modes.description: A final digit of a decimal number in a dosing or results table, followed by more numbers.

modes.label: Unit after a table value
modes.description: A unit such as g or Days right after a number in a table row.

modes.label: Bond table entry
modes.description: The second element in a bond pair in a bond strength table.

card.writes: It pushes toward a space and word starts, and away from contrast words like while, mostly in other languages.
card.plain: It marks the end of a number or unit inside a table of values, where another value comes next.
